title: Transcript
description: Transcript event published by the asr Lambda onto the signstream-bus EventBridge bus with detail-type 'signstream.transcript'. Carries one incremental partial transcript or one finalised segment. The text-to-gloss Lambda subscribes and reacts to finalised segments; partials are also pushed directly to the WebSocket client so captions appear live.

connectionId.description: API Gateway WebSocket connection ID of the originating client session. Carried so downstream stages can push their results back to the same client without an extra lookup.

language.description: Target sign language. Determines which per-language dictionary text-to-gloss will use.

text.description: The transcript text. Always English. May be empty in the case of a silence-detection finalisation with no recognised words.

isFinal.description: True when this is a finalised segment that will not be revised by later partials. text-to-gloss should only react to finals; partials are for live caption display.

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the asr Lambda emitted this event.

firstFrameSequence.description: Optional. Sequence number of the first audio frame that contributed to this transcript segment. Useful for latency analytics.

lastFrameSequence.description: Optional. Sequence number of the last audio frame that contributed to this segment.

asrModel.description: Optional. Identifier of the ASR model that produced this transcript. Useful when comparing models during evaluation.
